title: 第2528章 陆宸和慕容雪相认第2527章 陆宸界力突破神境
content_zh:
“嗡～”
空间颤动，两人来到一处清幽的山峰峰顶。
慕容雪原本一惊，不知发生了什么，可当看清面前的人是陆宸时，当即躬身行礼。
“晚辈慕容雪见过人皇大人！”
陆宸笑着调侃道：“呦呵，现在这么有礼貌，以前怎么没见你这么有礼貌？”
慕容雪想了一下，并未觉得自己过去哪里有过无理之处，但她并未争论什么。
她心里明白，眼前之人对她有救命之恩，又有护佑之情，是她此生的大恩人。
在这个时候，别说只是一句无关痛痒的话，哪怕要她去死，她也不会有丝毫犹豫。
慕容雪连忙道：“请人皇大人恕罪，晚辈以后一定注意，会对您有礼貌的。”
“好了，起来吧，跟你开个玩笑而已，你还当真了。”看着慕容雪紧张的模样，陆宸道。
“是！”慕容雪恭敬起身。
陆宸看向慕容雪问道：“老七，听说你一直在神武大陆，不知你可知老四现在什么情况？”
“老七？老四？”慕容雪一愣。
“是啊，老七，这才一百一十来年不见，你就忘记为师了？”陆宸佯装不悦。
闻言，慕容雪美眸圆瞪，死死的盯着陆宸。
她的身体都在微微颤抖着，像是要看出什么，但又并未找到任何熟悉的痕迹。
过了好一会，她期待又怀疑的问道：“您真……真是师尊？”
“傻丫头，除了你师尊，当今世上又有谁会救你，并且安排一群神境强者暗中保护你？”
陆宸笑着反问。
“可是……可是……”慕容雪声音变得哽咽，说不出后面的话，因为那是她一生的痛。

陆宸知道她想说什么，道：“为师当年确实陨落在了天魔山脉，但又重生了。”
说着，陆宸的面部开始蠕动，变回了自己的脸。
看着陆宸这张丰神如玉又年轻的脸庞，慕容雪有些恍惚，一时竟不知该说什么。
她在脑海中消化陆宸给的信息，过了好一会，她梳理着信息道：“人皇大人，您的意思是您是属下的师尊，您一百多年前陨落在了天魔山脉，随后重生成了现在这副模样，并且在短短百年时间里修炼到如今的修为，成为了当今世界的人皇？”
“是的！”陆宸点了点头。
“您觉得这可能吗？”慕容雪问道。
“你为何会觉得不可能？”陆宸反问。
慕容雪道：“虽然属下很想师尊，也想师尊还活着，但这是不可能的事情。”
“为什么？”陆宸问。
“因为属下的大师兄、二师兄和秦叔在内很多长辈当年师尊出事后都去过天魔山脉，并且带回了师尊的遗体。”慕容雪说。
陆宸皱眉：“你说老大他们去过天魔山脉，并带回了我的遗体？”
“是带回了属下师尊的遗体。”慕容雪说，并不相信眼前的陆宸会是她的师尊任逍遥。
陆宸的眉头皱得更紧了，因为他当年的肉身早就在对付魔族之时炸得渣都不剩了。
他在想，他的肉身明明没了，为何禽兽他们还能带回尸体，那尸体又是从哪来的。
content_en:
"Buzz~"
The space trembled, and the two came to the top of a quiet mountain peak.
Murong Xue was initially shocked and didn't know what was happening, but when she saw that the person in front of her was Lu Chen, she immediately bowed and saluted.
"Junior Murong Xue has met the Human Emperor!"
Lu Chen smiled and teased: "Hey, you are so polite now. Why haven't I seen you so polite before?"
Murong Xue thought for a moment and didn't feel that she had done anything unreasonable in the past, but she didn't argue.
She knew in her heart that the person in front of her had saved her life and protected her, and he was her great benefactor in this life.
At this time, let alone an innocuous remark, she would not hesitate at all even if she wanted to die.
Murong Xue said quickly: "Please forgive me, Your Majesty the Emperor. I will definitely pay attention to you in the future and be polite to you."
"Okay, get up, I'm just joking with you, but you take it seriously." Lu Chen said, looking at Murong Xue's nervous look.
"Yes!" Murong Xue stood up respectfully.
Lu Chen looked at Murong Xue and asked: "Lao Qi, I heard that you have been in Shenwu Continent. Do you know what is the situation of Lao Qi now?"
"Seventh child? Fourth child?" Murong Xue was stunned.
"Yes, Lao Qi, we haven't seen each other for more than a hundred and ten years, and you have forgotten that you are your master?" Lu Chen pretended to be displeased.
Hearing this, Murong Xue's beautiful eyes widened and she stared at Lu Chen.
Her body was trembling slightly, as if she wanted to see something, but she didn't find any familiar traces.
After a while, she asked expectantly and doubtfully: "Are you really...really Master?"
"Silly girl, besides your master, who else in the world today would save you and arrange for a group of powerful gods to protect you secretly?"
Lu Chen asked with a smile.
"But...but..." Murong Xue's voice became choked, and she couldn't say the next words, because it was the pain of her life.
Lu Chen knew what she wanted to say and said: "My master did fall in the Tianmo Mountains back then, but he was reborn again."
As he spoke, Lu Chen's face began to squirm and changed back to his own face.
Looking at Lu Chen's plump and young face, Murong Xue was a little dazed and didn't know what to say for a moment.
She digested the information given by Lu Chen in her mind. After a while, she sorted through the information and said: "Master Human Emperor, do you mean that you are my master. You fell in the Tianmo Mountains more than a hundred years ago, and then you were reborn into what you are now. In just a hundred years, you have reached your current level of cultivation and become the Human Emperor in today's world?"
"Yes!" Lu Chen nodded.
"Do you think this is possible?" Murong Xue asked.
"Why do you think it's impossible?" Lu Chen asked back.
Murong Xue said: "Although this subordinate misses Master very much and wishes that Master is still alive, this is impossible."
"Why?" Lu Chen asked.
"Because many of my elders, including my senior senior brother, second senior brother and Uncle Qin, went to the Tianmo Mountains after Master's accident and brought back Master's body." Murong Xue said.
Lu Chen frowned: "You said that Boss and the others went to the Demonic Mountains and brought back my body?"
"I brought back the body of my master." Murong Xue said, not believing that the Lu Chen in front of her was her master Ren Xiaoyao.
Lu Chen's brows furrowed even more tightly, because his physical body had been blown to pieces when dealing with the demons.
He was thinking, his body was obviously gone, why could the beasts and the others bring back the body, and where did the body come from.
